scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api,worker -c cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev -w @fantasy/web" "npm run dev -w @fantasy/api" "npm run dev -w @fantasy/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fantasy/api && npm run build -w @fantasy/worker && npm run build -w @fantasy/espn-bridge && npm run build -w @fantasy/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n web,api,worker "npm run start -w @fantasy/web" "npm run start -w @fantasy/api" "npm run start -w @fantasy/worker"
scripts.runtime:smoke: npm run build -w @fantasy/api && npm run build -w @fantasy/worker && npm run build -w @fantasy/espn-bridge && npm run build -w @fantasy/web && node scripts/runtime-smoke.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
